approved: Social Security Amendment (Australian Government Disaster Recovery Payment) Bill 2023
Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
The bill would make it easier to automatically process and quickly pay claims for the Australian Government Disaster Recovery Payment.

It would add a new way to qualify for the payment based on time spent in Australia before a disaster, as set by the minister, and treat certain people as carers of children when calculating the payment rate.
The changes are intended to apply from the 2023/24 High Risk Weather Season and beyond.
Adds a new alternative qualification criterion for the disaster payment based on time spent in Australia before a disaster.
Treats a person as a carer of a child for calculating the payment rate.
Makes minor technical amendments to clarify the use of the words 'declaration' and 'determination' in the Social Security Act 1991.
People affected by a major disaster who claim the Australian Government Disaster Recovery Payment.
Social Security Amendment (Australian Government Disaster Recovery Payment) Act 2023
